vocabulary.example: The once thriving colony was now in ruins after the attack.

vocabulary.definition: the fact or condition of being common or ordinary
vocabulary.example: Witnessing the cruel banality of nature was a stark reminder of life's harsh realities.

vocabulary.definition: the action of forcibly taking someone away against their will
vocabulary.example: The abduction of the ant larvae led to them becoming slaves in the Polyergus colony.

vocabulary.definition: the process of pressuring someone into adopting radically different beliefs by using systematic and often forcible means
vocabulary.example: The ants were brainwashed into serving the Polyergus colony without question.

vocabulary.definition: a person who takes a position of power or importance illegally or by force
vocabulary.example: After defeating the Formica queens, the Polyergus queen became the usurper of the colony.

vocabulary.definition: a body of troops or police officers, standing or moving in close formation
vocabulary.example: The attacking queen was stopped by a phalanx of workers defending the Formica colony.
